en: The spirit of the revealed religion has not yet overcome its consciousness as such, or, what is the same, its actual self-consciousness is not the object of its consciousness; it itself in general, and the moments that differentiate themselves within it, fall into the representing and into the form of objectivity.

The content of the representing is the absolute spirit; and it is solely a matter of sublating this mere form, or rather, because it belongs to consciousness as such, its truth must already have come about in the shapes of that consciousness.

– This overcoming of the object of consciousness is not to be taken in the one-sided sense that the object showed itself as returning into the self, but more determinately so: that it both, as such, presented itself to consciousness as vanishing, and still more, that it is the externalization of self-consciousness which posits thinghood, and that this externalization has not only a negative but a positive significance — not only for us or in itself, but for self-consciousness itself.

For it, the negative of the object, or its self-sublation, thereby has positive significance; or, it knows this nullity of the object, on the one hand, by externalizing itself — for in this externalization it posits itself as object, or, for the sake of the inseparable unity of being-for-itself, posits the object as itself.

On the other hand, there lies herein at the same time this other moment, that it has just as much sublated this externalization and objectivity and taken it back into itself, and is thus with itself in its otherness as such.
– This is the movement of consciousness, and in it consciousness is the totality of its moments.
– It must likewise comport itself toward the object according to the totality of its determinations, and must have grasped it in accordance with each one of these.

This totality of its determinations makes the object in itself into a spiritual essence; and for consciousness it truly becomes this through the grasping of each single one of these determinations as the self, or through the just-mentioned spiritual comportment toward them.
zh: 天启宗教的精神还没有克服它的意识本身，或者，这也就是说，它的现实的自我意识还不是它的意识的对象；它本身一般以及它在自身内相互区分出来的诸环节，都落入表象（活动）和对象性的形式之中。
表象（活动）的内容就是绝对精神；而剩下的只是要扬弃这种单纯的形式，或者不如说，由于这种形式属于意识本身，它的真理必定已经在意识的诸形态中产生出来了。
——对意识对象的这种克服，不应作这样片面的理解，即对象表现为返回到自身之中，而应更确定地作这样的理解：对象一方面作为它自身向意识呈现为消逝着的，另一方面更要看到，正是自我意识的外化设定了物性，而且这种外化不仅具有否定的意义，而且具有肯定的意义——这种意义不仅是对我们而言的或自在地具有的，而且是对自我意识自身而言的。
对自我意识而言，对象的否定者，即对象自身的自我扬弃，由此具有肯定的意义；或者说，它认识到对象的这种虚无性，一方面是通过把自己外化出来——因为在这种外化中，它把自己设定为对象，或者为了自为存在的不可分离的统一性，把对象设定为它自身。
另一方面，这里同时还包含着另一个环节，即自我意识同样也扬弃了这种外化和对象性，把它们收回自身之内，因而在它作为这样的他在中与自身同在。
——这就是意识的运动，意识在这种运动中就是它的诸环节的总体性。
——它同样必须按照其规定的总体性来对待对象，并且必须按照其中每一个规定这样地把握住对象。
这些规定的总体性使对象自在地成为精神本质；而对于意识来说，对象真正地成为精神本质，是通过把其中每一个别规定把握为自身，或者通过上面所说的对它们的精神性的对待。

en: The object is thus partly immediate being, or a thing in general, which corresponds to immediate consciousness; partly a becoming-other of itself, its relation, or being-for-another and being-for-itself, the determinacy, which corresponds to perception; partly essence, or, as universal, which corresponds to the understanding.

As a whole, it is the syllogism, or the movement of the universal through the determination to individuality, as well as the reverse [movement], from individuality, through it as sublated, or through the determination, to the universal.
– According to these three determinations, then, consciousness must know the object as itself.

However, it is not this knowing as pure comprehending of the object that is being spoken of; rather, this knowing is to be shown forth only in its becoming, or in its moments, according to the side that belongs to consciousness as such, and the moments of the genuine concept or of pure knowing [are to be shown] in the form of shapes of consciousness.

Therefore the object does not yet appear in consciousness as such as the spiritual essence, as it was just now expressed by us; and its comportment toward it is not the consideration of the object in this totality as such, nor in its pure conceptual form, but partly a shape of consciousness in general, partly a number of such shapes, which we take together and in which the totality of the moments of the object and of the comportment of consciousness can only be shown dissolved into its moments.
zh: 因此，对象一方面是直接的存在，即一个一般的物，这对应于直接的意识；另一方面是它自身的变成他者，即它的关系，或为他存在与自为存在，即规定性，这对应于知觉；再一方面是本质，或作为普遍的东西，这对应于知性。
作为整体，它就是推论，即普遍的东西通过规定而趋向个别性的运动，正如相反的运动，即从个别性出发、通过被扬弃的规定或通过规定本身而趋向普遍的东西。
——因此，按照这三种规定，意识必须把对象认作它自身。
然而，这里所谈的并不是作为对对象的纯粹概念把握的知识，而是这种知识只应当在其生成中，或者在其从属于意识本身的诸环节中被展示出来，并且只应当把真正概念或纯粹知识的诸环节，以意识的诸形态的形式展示出来。
因此，对象在意识本身中还不显现为精神的本质性，即我们刚才所道出的那种本质性；而意识对它的对待，也不是在这种总体性本身之中、或者在其纯粹的概念形式之中来考察对象，而是一部分是意识的一般形态，一部分是若干这样的形态，我们把它们总括起来，而在这些形态中，对象诸环节与意识对待方式的总体性，只能以消解在它的诸环节之中的方式被展示出来。

en: With this, for this side of the grasping of the object, as it is in the shape of consciousness, it is only a matter of recalling the earlier shapes of that consciousness which have already occurred.

– In regard to the object, then, insofar as it is an immediate, indifferent being, we saw the observing reason seek and find itself in this indifferent thing, i.e., be conscious of its doing as an equally external one, just as it is conscious of the object only as an immediate one.
– We also saw it, at its peak, express its determination in the infinite judgment that the being of the I is a thing.

And indeed a sensuous, immediate thing; if the I is called soul, then it is indeed also represented as a thing, but as an invisible, intangible one, etc.; in fact, therefore, not as immediate being, and not as what one means by a thing.
– That judgment, taken just as it immediately reads, is spirit-less, or rather the spirit-less itself.
But according to its concept it is in fact the most spirit-rich; and this inner of it, which is not yet present in it, is what the two other moments, still to be considered, express.
zh: 因此，就把握对象的这一方面，即把握对象处于意识的形态中的这一方面而言，只需回忆意识先前已经出现过的那些形态。
——那么，就对象而言，只要它是一个直接的、无差别的存在，我们就看到观察的理性在这个无差别的物中寻找自身并找到自身，也就是说，它意识到自己的行动是一种同样外在的行动，正如它只意识到对象是一个直接的存在一样。
——我们还看到，观察的理性在它的顶端，在无限判断中道出它的规定：「我」的存在是一个物。
而且是一个感性的、直接的物；如果「我」被称为灵魂，那么它固然也被表象为物，但被表象为看不见的、摸不着的等等；因此事实上并不是直接的存在，也不是人们意谓一个物时所指的那个东西。
——那个判断，照它直接读出来的样子来理解，是无精神的，或者不如说就是无精神者本身。
但按照它的概念，它事实上是最富有精神的东西；而它的这个内在者——它在这个判断中尚不在场——正是另外两个尚待考察的环节所道出的东西。

en: The thing is I; in fact, in this infinite judgment the thing is sublated; it is nothing in itself; it has significance only in the relation, only through the I and its relation to it.
– This moment has come forth for consciousness in pure insight and enlightenment.
Things are simply useful, and are to be considered only according to their usefulness.

– The cultivated self-consciousness, which has passed through the world of the self-estranged spirit, has, through its externalization, produced the thing as itself, therefore still retains itself in it, and knows the non-independence of the thing, or that the thing is essentially only being-for-another; or, to express fully the relation, i.e., that which here alone constitutes the nature of the object: the thing counts for it as a being-for-itself; it pronounces sense-certainty as absolute truth, but this very being-for-itself as a moment that only vanishes and passes over into its opposite, into the surrendered being-for-another.
zh: 物就是「我」；事实上，在这个无限判断中，物被扬弃了；它自在地什么也不是；它只在关系中、只有通过「我」以及「我」与它的关系才有意义。
——这个环节已经在纯粹识见和启蒙中为意识呈现出来了。
物是全然有用的，并且只应按照它们的有用性来考察。

——有教养的自我意识，即经历了自身异化了的精神的世界的那个自我意识，通过它的外化把物当作自身产生出来，因此仍然在物中保持着自身，并且知道物的不独立性，即知道物本质上只是为他存在；或者，把这种关系——即在这里单独构成对象之本质的那个东西——完全表达出来：那么，物对自我意识来说就是一个自为存在的东西，它把感性确定性道出为绝对真理，但把这个自为存在本身道出为一个环节，这个环节只是消逝着，并过渡到它的反面，即过渡到被舍弃的为他存在。

en: But herein the knowing of the thing is not yet completed; it must be known not only according to the immediacy of being and according to the determinacy, but also as essence, or as inner, as the self.
This is present in the moral self-consciousness.

It knows its knowing as the absolute essence, or being, pure and simple, as pure will or knowing; it is nothing but only this will and knowing; to something else there accrues only inessential being, i.e., not being-in-itself, only its empty husk.
Insofar as the moral consciousness releases the determinate being in its world-representation from the self, it just as much takes it back into itself.

As conscience it is finally no longer this still alternating placing and dissembling of determinate being and of the self, but it knows that its determinate being as such is this pure certainty of itself; the objective element, into which it places itself out as acting, is nothing other than the pure knowing of the self of itself.
zh: 但在这里，对物的知识还没有完成；物不仅必须按照存在的直接性和规定性被认识，而且必须作为本质或内在者、作为自身被认识。
这一点在道德的自我意识中已经存在。
它把它的知识认作绝对本质性，或者说把全然的存在认作纯粹的意志或知识；它除了这个意志和知识之外什么也不是；别的什么只分有非本质的存在，即不是自在存在的存在，只有它的空洞外壳。
道德的意识把它的世界表象中的定在从自身中释放出来，同样也把它收回自身之内。
作为良心，它最终不再是这样一种还对定在与自身进行交替安放和伪装的活动，而是知道它的定在本身正是这种对自身的纯粹确定性；它作为行动者把自己放出去的那个对象性的要素，无非是自身对自身的纯粹知识。

en: These are the moments out of which the reconciliation of spirit with its own proper consciousness is composed; for themselves they are single, and it is their spiritual unity alone which constitutes the force of this reconciliation.
But the last of these moments is necessarily this unity itself and, as is evident, actually binds them all together in itself.

The spirit certain of itself in its determinate being has, as the element of its determinate being, nothing other than this knowing of itself; the utterance that what it does it does out of conviction of duty — this its language is the validity of its acting.
– Acting is the first in-itself separation of the simplicity of the concept and the return out of this separation.

This first movement turns over into the second, in that the element of recognition sets itself, as simple knowing of duty, against the difference and the diremption which lies in acting as such and in this way forms an iron actuality against the acting.
But in forgiveness we saw how this hardness lets go of itself and externalizes itself.

Actuality therefore has here for self-consciousness — both as immediate determinate being — no other significance than to be pure knowing; – likewise, as determinate being or as relation, that which stands over against is a knowing partly of this purely single self, partly of the knowing as universal.

Herein is at the same time posited this, that the third moment, the universality or the essence, counts for each of the two standing over against each other only as knowing; and the empty, still remaining opposition they finally likewise sublate and are the knowing of Ich = Ich; this single self, which is immediately pure knowing or the universal.
zh: 这些就是精神与它固有的意识相和解所由构成的诸环节；它们各自是单个的，而唯有它们的精神性统一才构成这种和解的力。
但这些环节中的最后一个必然就是这个统一本身，并且显然，它实际上把这一切环节都联结在自身之内。
在自己的定在中对自己确定的精神，作为其定在的要素没有别的，只有这种对自己的知识；它说出：它所做的事情，它是出于对义务的确信而做的——这种它的语言就是它的行动的有效性。
——行动是概念之单纯性的第一个自在存在着的分离，也是从这一分离中的返回。
这第一个运动转变为第二个运动，因为承认的要素作为对义务的单纯知识，把自己与差别以及那种存在于行动本身中的分裂对立起来，并以这种方式形成一种与行动相对的铁的现实性。
但在宽恕中我们却看到，这种僵硬如何从自身放开、如何外化自己。
因此现实性在这里对自我意识来说——无论是作为直接定在——都没有别的意义，只有成为纯粹知识这一意义；——同样，作为特定定在或作为关系，那相对而立的东西是一种知识，部分是关于这个纯粹单个的自我的，部分是关于作为普遍者的知识的。
于此同时被设定的还有：第三个环节，即普遍性或本质，对两个相对而立者中的每一个都只算作知识；而那空洞的、仍然剩余的对立，他们最终也照样扬弃掉，并且是 Ich = Ich 的知识；这个单个的自我，它直接就是纯粹知识或普遍者。

en: This reconciliation of consciousness with self-consciousness hereby shows itself brought about from the twofold side: once in the religious spirit, the other time in consciousness itself as such.
They both differ from one another in this way, that the former has this reconciliation in the form of being-in-itself, the latter in the form of being-for-itself.

As they have been considered, they at first fall apart; consciousness, in the order in which its shapes came before us, has long since arrived partly at the single moments of them, partly at their unification, before religion too gave its object the shape of actual self-consciousness.

The unification of both sides is not yet shown; it is this which concludes this series of the shapes of spirit; for in it spirit comes to know itself not only as it is in itself or according to its absolute content, nor only as it is for itself according to its contentless form or according to the side of self-consciousness, but as it is in and for itself.
zh: 意识与自我意识的这种和解由此表现出是从双重方面实现出来的：一方面在宗教精神中，另一方面在意识本身之为意识中。
这两方面彼此区分开来，其方式在于：前者是在自在存在的形式中有这种和解，后者是在自为存在的形式中有这种和解。
正如它们被考察过的那样，它们起初是分裂开的；意识，在它的诸形态向我们显现出来的那个秩序中，早已部分地到达这些形态的各个单一环节、部分地到达它们的结合，那时宗教还没有赋予其对象以现实自我意识的形态。
双方的这种结合还没有被揭示出来；正是它终结精神的诸形态的这一系列；因为精神在其中达到了认识自己，不仅认识它自在地是什么或按其绝对内容是什么，也不仅认识它自为地按其无内容的形式或按自我意识这一面是什么，而是认识它自在自为地是什么。

en: But this unification has already happened in itself, indeed also in religion, in the return of representation into self-consciousness, but not in the proper form, for the religious side is the side of the in-itself, which stands over against the movement of self-consciousness.

The unification therefore belongs to this other side, which in the opposition is the side of reflection into itself, hence is the one that contains itself and its opposite — and not only in itself or in a universal way, but for itself, or developed and distinguished.

The content as well as the other side of self-conscious spirit, insofar as it is the other side, is present and has been shown in its completeness; the unification which still is lacking is the simple unity of the concept.

This is also already present on the side of self-consciousness itself; but as it occurred in the foregoing, it has, like all the remaining moments, the form of being a particular shape of consciousness.
– It is therefore that part of the shape of the spirit certain of itself which remains standing within its concept and was called the beautiful soul.

For it is its knowing of itself, in its pure transparent unity — the self-consciousness which knows this pure knowing of the pure being-in-itself as the spirit, not only the intuition of the divine but the self-intuition of the same.

– In that this concept holds itself fast set against its realization, it is the one-sided shape whose disappearance into empty vapor, but also whose positive externalization and moving-forward we saw.

Through this realization the persistence-on-itself of this objectless self-consciousness, the determinacy of the concept against its fulfilment, sublates itself; its self-consciousness wins the form of universality, and what remains to it is its true concept, or the concept that has won its realization; it is this in its truth, namely in the unity with its externalization — the knowing of pure knowing, not as an abstract essence, which is duty, but of it as the essence which is this knowing, this pure self-consciousness, which is thus at the same time a true object, for it is the self existing for itself.
zh: 但这种结合自在的已经发生了，诚然在宗教中、在表象返回自我意识中也发生了，但不是按固有的形式发生的，因为宗教那一面是自在的一面，它站在自我意识运动的对面。
因此这种结合属于这另一面，它在对立中是在自身中的反思这一面，因而是把自身和自身的对立面包含于自身的那一面，而且不是仅仅自在地或以一种普遍的方式，而是自为地、即发展了的并且区分开了地包含。
内容以及自我意识的精神的另一面——就其是另一面而言——在其完整性中都已现存并且被揭示出来；还欠缺的那种结合，就是概念的单纯统一。
这个统一在自我意识那一面本身也早已现存；但正如它在前面出现的那样，它和其余一切环节一样具有这样的形式：是一种特殊的意识形态。
——它因而是对自己确定的精神这一形态中的那一部分，这部分停留在自己的概念中，并且被称作美的灵魂。
因为它就是精神对自身的那种知识，在其纯粹而透明的统一中——即那个自我意识，它把这种对纯粹自身内存在的纯粹知识认作精神，不只是对神性东西的直观，而是对同一个东西的自我直观。
——由于这个概念把自己与自己的实现对立起来地坚持着，它就是那片面形态；我们看到了它消失在空虚的云雾中，但也看到了它的正面的外化和前进运动。

通过这种实现，这个无对象的自我意识的坚持于自身——即概念相对于其充实的那个规定性——就自我扬弃了；它的自我意识获得普遍性的形式，而留给它的就是它真正的概念，或者说那个赢得了自己实现的概念；它是在自己的真理中的这个，即在与自己外化的统一中——是对纯粹知识的知识，不是把它当作作为义务的那个抽象本质，而是把它当作这样的本质：它就是这种知识、这个纯粹自我意识，因此同时就是真正的对象，因为它是自为存在的自我。

en: This concept gave itself its fulfilment on the one hand in the acting, self-certain spirit, on the other hand in religion: in the latter it won the absolute content as content, or in the form of representation, of otherness for consciousness; whereas in the former shape the form is the self itself, for it contains the acting, self-certain spirit; the self carries the life of the absolute spirit through.
This shape is, as we see, that simple concept which, however, gives up its eternal essence, is there or acts.
The diremption or stepping-forth he has at the purity of the concept, for it is the absolute abstraction or negativity.

Likewise he has the element of his actuality or of the being in it at the pure knowing itself, for it is the simple immediacy which is just as much being and determinate being as essence, the former the negative thinking, the latter the positive thinking itself.
This determinate being is finally just as much the being-reflected-into-itself or being-evil that comes out of it — both as determinate being and as duty.
This going-into-itself constitutes the opposition of the concept and is thereby the emergence of the non-acting, non-actual pure knowing of the essence.

But this its emergence in this opposition is the participation in it; the pure knowing of the essence has in itself externalized its simplicity, for it is the diremption or the negativity which the concept is; insofar as this diremption is the becoming-for-itself, it is the evil; insofar as it is the in-itself, it is the remaining-good.
– What happens at first in itself is at the same time for consciousness and likewise itself twofold, both for it, insofar as it is its being-for-itself or its own doing.
The same that is already posited in itself thus repeats itself now as the knowing of consciousness about it and as conscious doing.
Each lets go, for the other, of the independence of the determinacy in which it appears against it.

This letting-go is the same renunciation of the one-sidedness of the concept which in itself constituted the beginning; but it is now its own renunciation, just as the concept on which it renounces is its own.

– That in-itself of the beginning is, as negativity, in truth just as much the mediated; as it is in truth, it thus now sets itself, and the negative is, as determinacy of each for the other and in itself, the self-sublating.

One of the two parts of the opposition is the inequality of the being-within-itself-in-its-singularity against the universality — the other is the inequality of its abstract universality against the self; the former dies away to its being-for-itself, externalizes itself, confesses; the latter renounces the hardness of its abstract universality and thereby dies away to its lifeless self and its unmoved universality; so that the former has completed itself through the moment of universality which is essence, and the latter through the universality which is self.

Through this movement of acting, the spirit — which is spirit only in that it is there, raises its determinate being into thought and thereby into absolute opposition, and returns from this precisely through it and in it itself — has stepped forth as pure universality of knowing, which is self-consciousness, as self-consciousness which is simple unity of knowing.
zh: 这个概念一方面在行动着的、对自己确定的精神中给了自己充实，另一方面在宗教中：在宗教里它赢得绝对内容作为内容，或作为表象的形式、作为为意识的他在；反之，在前一种形态中，形式就是自我本身，因为它包含着行动着的、对自己确定的精神；自我贯彻绝对精神的整个生命。
这种形态，如我们所见，就是那个单纯的概念，但它放弃自己的永恒本质，定在着或行动着。
分裂或显现，他是在概念的纯粹性那里具有的，因为概念的纯粹性就是绝对抽象或否定性。
同样，他的现实性或其中存在的要素，他是在纯粹知识本身那里具有的，因为纯粹知识就是单纯的直接性，它既是存在和定在，又同样是本质，前者是否定性思维，后者则是肯定性思维本身。
这种定在最终同样是从它——既作为定在也作为义务——返回到自身中的存在，即为恶的存在。
这种返回自身构成概念的对立，并因而是不行动着的、不现实的、对本质的纯粹知识的登场。
但它在这个对立中的这种登场就是对它的参与；对本质的纯粹知识已自在地外化了自己的单纯性，因为它就是概念所是的那个分裂或否定性；这种分裂只要是自为化，它就是恶；只要它是自在，它就是保持善的东西。
——那起初自在地发生的东西，同时也就是为着意识的，并且本身同样是双重的，既是为着它的，就其是它的自为存在或它自己的行动而言。
那已自在地被设定的同一个东西，现在因此作为意识对它的知识、作为自觉的行动而重复自身。
每一方都为另一方而放开那种规定性的独立性——它正是带着这种规定性出现在对方面前的。
这种放开就是对概念之片面性的那种放弃，这放弃自在地构成了开端；但它现在就是它自己的放弃，正如它所要放弃的那个概念是它自己的概念一样。
——开端的那个自在作为否定性，在真理中同样也是被中介的；正因为它如其在真理中所是，它现在就把自己设定起来，而否定者作为每一方对另一方的规定性、并且自在地就是那自我扬弃的东西。
对立的两个部分中，一个是「在其个别性中自身内存在」对普遍性的不等同——另一个是它的抽象普遍性对自我的不等同；前者对它的自为存在渐渐死去、外化自己、忏悔自己；后者弃绝其抽象普遍性的僵硬，并因此对它无生命的自我和它不动的普遍性渐渐死去；所以前者通过作为本质的普遍性这一环节、后者通过作为自我的普遍性，已经补足了自己。
通过行动的这种运动，精神——它正因如此才成其为精神：它定在着，把它的定在提升到思维中、并由此提升到绝对对立中，又从这种对立中恰恰通过它并在它自身之内返回——作为知识之纯粹普遍性、即作为自我意识，也作为那构成知识之单纯统一的自我意识，显现出来了。

en: What therefore was in religion the content or form of the representation of an Other is here the self's own doing; the concept connects that the content is the self's own doing; for this concept is, as we see, the knowledge of the self's doing in itself as all essentiality and all determinate being, the knowledge of this subject as the substance and of the substance as this knowledge of its doing.

– What we have added here is only, on the one hand, the assembling of the individual moments, each of which in its principle presents the life of the whole spirit, and, on the other hand, the holding fast of the concept in the form of the concept, whose content has already given itself up in those moments and which has already given itself up in the form of a shape of consciousness.
zh: 所以，在宗教里曾经是一个他者的表象之内容或形式的东西，在这里就是自我自己的行动；概念把内容就是自我自己的行动这一点联结起来；因为这个概念，正如我们所看到的，就是自我行动在自身内作为一切本质性和一切定在的知识，就是对作为实体的这个主体的知识，以及对作为对它自己行动的这种知识的实体的知识。
——我们在这里所增添的，仅仅是一方面把各个别的环节汇集起来，其中每一个环节都在其原则中表现出整个精神的生命，另一方面把概念保持在概念的形式中，而它的内容已经在那些环节中、并且它也已经以某种意识的形态的形式自行呈现出来了。

en: This last shape of spirit, the spirit which gives to its complete and true content at the same time the form of the self and thereby realizes its concept just as much as it remains, in this realization, within its concept, is absolute knowing; it is the spirit knowing itself in the shape of spirit, or the comprehending knowing.

Truth is not only in itself completely equal to certainty, but also has the shape of certainty of itself, or it is in its determinate being, i.e. (d.h.) for the knowing spirit, in the form of knowing of itself.
Truth is the content which in religion is still unequal to its certainty.
This equality, however, consists in the content's having received the shape of the self.
Through this, that which is the essence itself, namely the concept, has become the element of determinate being or the form of objectivity for consciousness.
Spirit, appearing to consciousness in this element or — what here is the same — brought forth by it therein, is Science.
zh: 精神这最后的形态——那给自己的完满而真的内容同时赋予自我的形式，并因此实现自己的概念、正如同它在这种实现中仍停留在自己的概念里的精神——就是绝对知识；它就是在精神形态中认识自身的精神，就是以概念把握的知识。
真理不仅自在地完全与确定性相等，而且也具有对自身的确定性的形态，或者说，它在它的定在中，即（d.h.）对于有知的精神而言，处于对他自身的知识的形式中。
真理就是那个在宗教中还与它的确定性不相等的内容。
但这种相等却在于：内容已经获得了自我的形态。
由此，那本身就是本质的东西，即概念，就成了定在的要素，或者说成了对意识而言的对象性的形式。
精神，在这个要素中向意识显现，或者——在这里这是一回事——在其中由它产生出来，就是科学。

en: The nature, the moments, and the movement of this knowing have thus turned out such that it is the pure being-for-itself of self-consciousness; it is the I that is this and no other I and that is just as immediately a mediated, or sublated, universal I.
– It has a content which it distinguishes from itself, for it is the pure negativity or the self-diremption; it is consciousness.
This content is in its difference itself the I, for it is the movement of self-sublation, or the same pure negativity that the I is.
The I is reflected in it, as something distinguished, into itself; the content is comprehended solely through this, that the I is with itself in its otherness.

This content, stated more determinately, is nothing other than the movement just expressed itself; for it is the spirit that runs through itself, and indeed for itself as spirit, through the fact that it has the shape of the concept in its objectivity.
zh: 这种知识的本性、环节和运动，于是就表现为：它就是自我意识的纯粹自为存在；它就是我，是这个我而不是别的我，并且同样直接地是一个被中介的、或被扬弃了的普遍的我。
——它有一个内容，它把这个内容同自身区别开来，因为它就是纯粹的否定性或自身分裂；它是意识。
这个内容在它的差别中本身就是我，因为它是自身扬弃的运动，或者说就是那作为我的同一个纯粹的否定性。
我作为被区别开的东西，在它里面反思进自身内；内容仅仅由于我在自己的他在中处在自身那里，才被以概念把握。
这个内容，更确切地说，不是别的，正是刚才说出的那个运动本身；因为它是那走遍自身、并且自为地作为精神走遍自身的精神，而它之所以如此，是由于它在它的对象性中具有概念的形态。

en: But as concerns the determinate being of this concept, science does not appear in time and actuality any earlier than when spirit has come to this consciousness about itself.

As the spirit that knows what it is, it does not exist earlier, nor anywhere else, than after the completion of the work, namely of subduing its imperfect formation, of procuring for its consciousness the shape of its essence, and of bringing its self-consciousness into equilibrium with its consciousness in this way.

– The spirit that is in and for itself, distinguished in its moments, is knowing that is for-itself, comprehending in general, which as such has not yet reached the substance or is not in itself absolute knowing.
zh: 但就这个概念的定在而言，科学在时间与现实性中出现，不会早于精神达到了关于它自身的这种意识的时候。
作为知道自己是什么的精神，它不早于、也不在任何别处存在于这场劳作完成之后——这场劳作就是：克服自己不完善的成形，为它的意识取得它的本质的形态，并以这种方式使它的自我意识与它的意识相平衡。
——那自在自为地存在着的、在其环节中被区别开来的精神，就是自为存在着的知识，就是一般的概念把握；这种概念把握作为这样的东西还没有达到实体，或者说自在地本身还不是绝对知识。

en: In actuality, however, the knowing substance is there earlier than the form or concept-shape of the same.
For the substance is the not-yet-developed in-itself, or the ground and the concept in its still unmoved simplicity, hence the inwardness or the self of spirit that is not yet there.
What is there is, as the not-yet-developed simple and immediate, or the object of representing consciousness in general.

Cognition, because it is spiritual consciousness, is related to what is in itself only insofar as it is being for the self and being of the self, or concept; for this reason it at first has only a poor object, in comparison with which the substance and its consciousness are richer.
The revealedness that it has in this is in fact hiddenness, for it is the still self-less being, and only the certainty of itself is revealed to itself.

At first, therefore, only the abstract moments of the substance belong to self-consciousness; but as these, as pure movements, drive themselves onward, it enriches itself, until it has wrested the whole substance from consciousness, sucked into itself the whole edifice of its essentialities, and — since this negative comportment toward objectivity is just as much positive, a positing — generated it out of itself and thereby at the same time restored it for consciousness.
In the concept that knows itself as concept, the moments hereby appear earlier than the fulfilled whole, whose becoming is the movement of those moments.
In consciousness, on the contrary, the whole — but a non-comprehended one — is earlier than the moments.

– Time is the concept itself that is there and presents itself to consciousness as empty intuition; therefore spirit necessarily appears in time, and it appears in time as long as it has not grasped its pure concept, i.e. (d.h.) has not annulled time.

It is the outer, intuited, by the self not grasped pure self, the concept that is only intuited; in that this grasps itself, it sublates its time-form, comprehends the intuiting, and is a comprehended and comprehending intuition.

– Time therefore appears as the fate and the necessity of the spirit that is not completed in itself, – the necessity to enrich the share that self-consciousness has in consciousness, to set the immediacy of the in-itself — the form in which the substance is in consciousness — into motion, or conversely, taking the in-itself as the inward, to realize and reveal what is at first only inward, i.e. (d.h.) to vindicate it for the certainty of itself.
zh: 然而在现实性中，有知的实体比它的形式或概念形态更早地在那里。
因为实体是那尚未展开的自在，或者说是在它那尚未运动的简单性中的根据和概念，因此也就是精神的那种尚不在那里的内在性或自我。
在那里存在的东西，作为那尚未展开的简单而直接的东西，或者说作为一般的表象着的意识的对象。
认识，因为它是精神的意识，所以对于那自在存在的东西，只在它是为自我的存在和自我的存在、或者是概念时才与之相关；基于这个理由，它起初只有一个贫乏的对象，而实体及其意识与之相比则更丰富。
它在这种对象中所具有的显明性，事实上是遮蔽性，因为它是那还无自我的存在，而对自身显明的只有对它自身的确定性。
因此，起初属于自我意识的只是实体的抽象环节；但一旦这些环节作为纯粹的运动推动自身前进，它便充实自己，直到它把整个实体从意识那里夺走、把实体本质性的整个大厦吸入自身，并且——由于这种对对象性的否定性态度同样也是肯定性的，是一种设定——从自身中把它产生出来，并由此同时为意识把它重新建立起来。
在把自己作为概念来认识的概念中，环节们由此比那充实了的整体更早出现，而这个整体的生成就是那些环节的运动。
相反，在意识中，整体——但那是未被以概念把握的整体——比环节更早。
——时间就是那个存在着的概念本身，它作为空洞的直观向意识呈现自身；因此精神必然出现在时间中，而且只要精神还没有把握它的纯粹概念，即（d.h.）还没有消除时间，它就一直在时间中出现。
它是那外在的、被直观的、未被自我把握的纯粹自我，是那仅被直观的概念；当这个概念把握自身时，它就扬弃它的时间形式，以概念把握直观，并且就是被以概念把握的、同时以概念把握着的直观。
——因此，时间表现为那尚未在自身中完成的精神的命运和必然性——即这样的一种必然性：充实自我意识在意识中所占有的份额，把自在的直接性——也就是实体在意识中所处的那种形式——发动起来；或者反过来，把自在当作内在的东西来把握，去实现并揭示那起初只是内在的东西，即（d.h.）把它归属于对自身的确定性。

en: For this reason it must be said that nothing is known which is not in experience, or, however the same thing is also expressed, which is not present as felt truth, as an inwardly revealed eternal, as a believed holy, or whatever other expressions may be used.
For experience is precisely this, that the content — and it is spirit — is in itself, is substance, and hence is the object of consciousness.
But this substance, which spirit is, is its own becoming to that which it is in itself; and only as this becoming that reflects itself into itself is it, in itself, in truth the spirit.

It is in itself the movement that cognition is — the transformation of that in-itself into the for-itself, of substance into subject, of the object of consciousness into the object of self-consciousness, i.e. into an object that is just as much sublated, or into the concept.
It is the circle that returns into itself, which presupposes its beginning and reaches it only in the end.

– Insofar as spirit is thus necessarily this distinguishing-within-itself, its whole, intuited, steps over against its simple self-consciousness; and since that whole is what is distinguished, it is distinguished into its pure concept, into time, and into the content or into the in-itself; the substance, as subject, has in itself the first inner necessity of presenting itself at itself as what it is in itself, namely as spirit.
The completed objective presentation is first at the same time the reflection of it, or its becoming to self.
– Before, therefore, spirit has not completed itself in itself, not as world-spirit, it cannot as self-conscious spirit reach its consummation.
The content of religion therefore expresses earlier in time than science does what spirit is, but only science is its true knowledge of itself.
zh: 因此必须说：凡不在经验之中的东西就没有被认识；或者，无论同一件事以别的什么方式表达——凡不是作为被感受的真理、作为内在地被启示的永恒者、作为被信仰的圣者，或者无论人们还使用别的什么说法——而现存着的东西，就没有被认识。
因为经验恰恰就是这样一回事：内容——而内容就是精神——自在地是实体，因而也是意识的对象。
但这个精神所是的实体，就是它向它自在地所是的东西的生成；而只有作为这种在自身中反思自身的生成，它才自在地、在真理上就是精神。
它自在地就是那构成认识的运动——即把那个自在转化为自为、把实体转化为主体、把意识的对象转化为自我意识的对象，亦即转化为同样被扬弃了的对象或转化为概念的运动。
它是向自身中回归的圆圈，这个圆圈预设了自己的开端，并且只在终点才达到它。
——因此，只要精神必然地就是这种在自身之内的区分，它的整体就作为被直观到的东西站到它那简单的自我意识对面；而由于那个整体就是被区分出来的东西，它就被区分成它的纯粹概念、时间和内容或自在；实体作为主体，在自身那里首先具有这种内在的必然性：在自身那里把自己呈现为它自在地所是的东西，即呈现为精神。
完成了的对象性呈现，首先同时才就是它的反思，或者说它向自我的生成。
——因此，在精神还没有自在地、还没有作为世界精神完成自身之前，它就不能作为自我意识的精神达到它的完成。
因此，宗教的内容在时间上比科学更早地说出精神是什么，但只有科学才是精神对自身的真的知识。

en: The movement of driving forth the form of its knowing of itself is the work that it accomplishes as actual history.

The religious community, insofar as it is at first the substance of absolute spirit, is the crude consciousness which has an all the more barbaric and harder determinate being the deeper its inner spirit is, and whose dull self [has] an all the harder work with its essence, the content of its consciousness that is foreign to it.

Only after it has given up the hope of sublating the being-foreign in an external, i.e. foreign manner, does it turn — because the sublated foreign manner is the return into self-consciousness — to itself, to its own world and present, discover it as its property and have thus taken the first step of descending from the intellectual world, or rather of inspiriting its abstract element with the actual self.
Through observation it finds, on the one hand, the determinate being as thought and comprehends it, and conversely, in its thinking, the determinate being.

In that it has thus at first itself abstractly expressed the immediate unity of thinking and being, of the abstract essence and the self, and expressed the first being-of-light more purely, namely as the unity of extension and being — for extension is the simplicity that is more equal to pure thinking than light is — and has thereby reawakened in thought the substance of the rising, the spirit at the same time recoils from this abstract unity, from this selfless substantiality, and asserts individuality against it.

But only after it has externalized this [individuality] in formation, thereby made it into determinate being and carried it through in all determinate being — has come to the thought of usefulness and in absolute freedom grasped determinate being as its will — does it thus turn outward the thought of its innermost depth and express the essence as Ich = Ich.

But this Ich = Ich is the movement that reflects itself into itself; for in that this equality, as absolute negativity, is the absolute difference, the self-equality of the I stands over against this pure difference, which, as the pure and at the same time objective difference for the self that knows itself, is to be expressed as time, so that, just as above the essence was expressed as the unity of thinking and extension, it would have to be grasped as the unity of thinking and time; but the difference left to itself, the restless and stayless time, collapses rather into itself; it is the objective rest of extension, but this is the pure equality with itself, the I.
– Or the I is not only the self, but it is the equality of the self with itself; this equality, however, is the perfect and immediate unity with itself, or this subject is just as much the substance.

The substance alone for itself would be the content-less intuiting, or the intuiting of a content which, as determinate, would have only accidentality and would be without necessity; the substance would count as the absolute only insofar as it were thought or intuited as the absolute unity, and all content would, according to its diversity, have to fall outside it into the reflection that does not belong to it, because it would not be grasped as subject, not as that which reflects over itself and into itself, or not as spirit.

If, nevertheless, a content were to be spoken of, then it would be partly only in order to throw it into the empty abyss of the absolute, partly, however, it would be externally picked up from sensuous perception; knowing would seem to have come to things, to the difference from itself, and to the difference of manifold things, without one's comprehending how and whence.
zh: 把关于自身的知识的形式驱迫出来的那种运动，就是精神作为现实的历史所完成的劳作。
宗教教团，只要它首先还是绝对精神的实体，就是粗糙的意识；这种意识的内在精神越深，它的定在就越野蛮、越严酷，它那迟钝的自我同它的本质——即对它来说异己的意识内容——所进行的劳作就越艰苦。
只有当它放弃了以外在的、即异己的方式去扬弃异己存在的希望之后，它才——因为被扬弃的异己方式就是向自我意识的回归——转向自身，转向它自己的世界和当下，把它们发现为它的财产，从而迈出了第一步：从理智世界降下来，或者毋宁说，用现实的自我去赋予理智世界的抽象元素以精神。
通过观察，它一方面把定在作为思想来发现并以概念把握它，反过来又在它的思维中发现定在。
由于它这样首先本身抽象地宣说了思维与存在的直接统一、抽象本质与自我的直接统一，并且更纯粹地宣说了第一个光明本质，即把它宣说为广延与存在的统一——因为广延是比光更接近纯粹思维的单纯性——并从而在思想中重新唤起了升起之光的实体，精神同时也就从这种抽象的统一、从这种无自我的实体性中惊退回来，并坚持个体性来反对它。
但只有当它在这种教养中外化了这种个体性，由此把它变成定在并在一切定在中贯彻了它——达到了有用性的思想，并在绝对自由中把定在把握为它的意志——它才从而把最内在深处的思想翻出来，并把本质表述为 Ich = Ich。

但这个 Ich = Ich 却是那种在自身中反思自身的运动；因为，由于这种等同作为绝对的否定性就是绝对的差别，我的自我等同就与这种纯粹的差别相对立，而这种纯粹的差别作为纯粹的、同时又是对那个认识自身的自我而言对象性的差别，必须被宣说为时间；因此，正如先前本质被宣说为思维与广延的统一，它也就应当被把握为思维与时间的统一；但是，听任自身摆布的差别，即那无静止、无停留的时间，毋宁说在自身中坍塌了；它是广延的对象性的静止，而这种静止就是与自身的纯粹等同，即我。
——或者，我不仅是自我，而且是自我与自身的等同；但这种等同就是与自身的完满的、直接的统一，或者说，这个主体同样也是实体。
独自自为的实体将是无内容的直观，或者是对一种内容的直观，这种内容作为特定的内容只有偶性、没有必然性；实体只有在被思维或被直观为绝对统一时，才被视为绝对者；而一切内容按其相异都必定落到实体之外、落入那种不属于实体的反思之中，因为实体没有被把握为主体，没有被把握为那种反思到自身之上并在自身中反思自身的东西，或者说没有被把握为精神。
假如毕竟还是要谈论一种内容，那么这种谈论一部分只是为了把它抛进绝对者的空洞深渊，一部分则只是把它从感性知觉中外在地捡拾起来；知识看来似乎达到了物、达到了它同自身的差别以及杂多事物的差别，却没有人理解它是如何达到的、从哪里达到的。

en: But spirit has shown itself to us to be neither merely the withdrawal of self-consciousness into its pure inwardness, nor the mere immersion of it in the substance and the non-being of its difference, but rather this movement of the self which externalizes itself and immerses itself in its substance and, equally as subject, has gone out of it into itself and makes it into object and content, in that it sublates this difference of objectivity and content.
That first reflection out of immediacy is the self-differentiating of the subject from its substance, or the concept that dirempts itself, the going-into-itself and becoming of the pure I.
In that this difference is the pure doing of the Ich = Ich, the concept is the necessity and the rising of the determinate being which has the substance as its essence and subsists for itself.

But the subsistence of the determinate being for itself is the concept posited in determinacy, and thereby equally its movement at itself, to go down into the simple substance, which is subject only as this negativity and movement.

– The I has neither to hold itself fast in the form of self-consciousness over against the form of substantiality and objectivity, as if it were afraid of its externalization — the power of spirit is rather to remain equal to itself in its externalization and, as the being that is in-and-for-itself, to posit the being-for-itself just as much only as a moment as the being-in-itself — nor is it a third that throws the differences back into the abyss of the absolute and expresses their equality therein; rather, knowing consists in this apparent inactivity, which only contemplates how the distinguished moves at itself and returns into its unity.
zh: 但精神已经向我们表明：它既不只是自我意识退回到它的纯粹内在性之中，也不只是自我意识单纯沉没在实体之中、沉没在它差别的非存在之中，而是自我的这样一种运动：自我外化自身，沉没进它的实体之中，同样也作为主体从实体中回到自身，并把实体变成对象和内容，同时扬弃了对象性与内容的这种差别。
那第一种从直接性中出来的反思，就是主体与其实体的区分自身，或者说自我分裂的概念，就是纯粹的我进入自身和生成。
由于这种差别就是 Ich = Ich 的纯粹行动，概念就是定在的必然性和升起，这个定在以实体为其本质，并且自为地持存着。
但定在的自为持存，就是在规定性中被设定的概念，因而同样也是概念在自身那里的运动，即下降到单纯的实体之中的运动；而实体只有作为这种否定性和运动才是主体。
——我既不必以自我意识的形式来固守自身、对抗实体性和对象性的形式，好像它害怕自己的外化似的——精神的力量毋宁在于：在外化中保持自身等同，并且作为自在自为的存在者，把自为存在与自在存在同样都只设定为环节——我也不必是什么第三者，把种种差别抛回绝对者的深渊并在其中宣说它们的等同；毋宁说，知识就在于这种表面上的无所作为，它只是旁观那有差别的东西如何在自身那里运动、如何回到它的统一之中。

en: In knowing, spirit has thus concluded the movement of its forming, insofar as the latter is burdened with the unovercome difference of consciousness.
It has won the pure element of its determinate being, the concept.
The content, according to the freedom of its being, is the self that externalizes itself, or the immediate unity of self-knowing.
The pure movement of this externalization constitutes, when it is considered at the content, its necessity.

The different content, as determinate, is in the relation, not in itself, and is its restlessness to sublate itself, or the negativity; thus the necessity or diversity is, like the free being, just as much the self; and in this self-like form, in which the determinate being is immediately thought, the content is the concept.
In that spirit has thus won the concept, it unfolds the determinate being and movement in this ether of its life, and is science.

The moments of its movement present themselves in it no longer as determinate shapes of consciousness, but, in that the difference of the latter has gone back into the self, as determinate concepts and as the organic, in-itself-grounded movement of them.

If in the Phenomenology of Spirit each moment is the difference of knowing and truth and the movement in which it sublates itself, then science, by contrast, does not contain this difference and its sublating; rather, in that the moment has the form of the concept, it unites the objective form of truth and of the knowing self in immediate unity.

The moment does not step forth as this movement, of going over and back from consciousness or representation into self-consciousness and conversely; rather, its pure shape, freed from its appearance in consciousness — the pure concept and its further movement — hangs alone on its pure determinacy.
Conversely, to every abstract moment of science there corresponds a shape of the appearing spirit as such.
Just as the existing spirit is not richer than it, so in its content it is also not poorer.

To cognize the pure concepts of science in this form of shapes of consciousness constitutes the side of their reality, according to which their essence — the concept, which is posited in it in its simple mediation as thinking — splits apart the moments of this mediation and presents itself according to the inner opposition.
zh: 因此，精神在知识中完结了它形态化的运动，只要这种形态化还带有意识的那种未被克服的差别。
精神赢得了它定在的纯粹元素——概念。
按其存在的自由来说，内容就是外化自身的自我，或者说自我知识的直接统一。
这种外化的纯粹运动，如果从内容方面来考察它，就构成了内容的必然性。
那有差别的、作为特定的内容处在关系中而不是自在的，并且就是扬弃自身的那种不安，即否定性；因此，必然性或相异，如同自由的存在一样，同样也是自我；而在这种自我的形式中——定在在这种形式里直接就是思想——内容就是概念。
因此，由于精神赢得了概念，它就在它生命的这个以太中展开定在和运动，并且就是科学。
它运动的诸环节在其中不再表现为意识的特定形态，而是——由于意识的差别已经回到自我之中——表现为特定概念，表现为这些概念的那种有机的、在自身中奠定基础的运动。
如果说在《精神现象学》中，每一个环节都是知识与真理的差别，都是这种差别在其中扬弃自身的运动，那么与此相反，科学并不包含这种差别及其扬弃；而是，由于环节具有概念的形式，它就把真理的对象性形式和认识着的自我的对象性形式在直接统一中结合起来。
环节并不作为这种运动——即从意识或表象进入自我意识、又反过来来回穿梭——而出现；相反，它的纯粹的、摆脱了它在意识中的现象的形态，即纯粹概念及其继续推进，只系于它的纯粹规定性。
反过来，科学的每一个抽象环节，都对应着显现着的精神的一种形态。
正如定在着的精神并不比科学更富有，它在内容上也不比科学更贫乏。
在意识形态的这种形式中去认识科学的纯粹概念，就构成了它们的实在性的那一面；按照这一面，它们的本质——即在科学中、在其作为思维的简单中介里被设定的那个概念——把这种中介的诸环节展开，并按照内在的对立把自己呈现出来。

en: Science contains within itself this necessity to externalize itself from the form of the pure concept, and the transition of the concept into consciousness.

For the spirit that knows itself, precisely because it grasps its concept, is the immediate equality with itself which, in its difference, is the certainty of the immediate, or sense-consciousness – the beginning from which we set out; this release of itself from the form of its self is the highest freedom and security of its knowledge of itself.
zh: 科学在自身中包含着这种必然性：把自己从纯粹概念的形式中外化出来，以及概念向意识的过渡。
因为自身知道自己的精神，正由于它把握了自己的概念，它才是与自身的直接等同，这种等同在其差别中是对直接者的确定性，或者说感性意识——我们由之出发的开端；这种把自身从自身的形式中释放出去，是它对自身的知识的最高自由和可靠性。

en: Yet this externalization is still incomplete; it expresses the relation of the certainty of itself to the object, which, precisely in being in that relation, has not won its complete freedom.
Knowing knows not only itself, but also the negative of itself, or its limit.
To know its limit means to know how to sacrifice oneself.

This self-sacrifice is the externalization in which spirit exhibits its becoming spirit in the form of free contingent happening, intuiting its pure self as the time outside it, and equally its being as space.

This latter becoming of it, nature, is its living immediate becoming; it, the externalized spirit, is in its determinate being nothing but this eternal externalization of its subsistence and the movement that the subject produces.
zh: 但这种外化还不完善；它表达的是对自身的确定性与对象的关系，而对象恰恰因为处于这种关系之中，还没有赢得自己的完全自由。
知识不仅知道自身，也知道自身的否定物，或者说自己的界限。
知道自己的界限，就是知道如何牺牲自己。
这种牺牲就是外化，精神在这种外化中，以自由的、偶然发生的形态表现自己向精神的生成，同时把自己的纯粹自我直观为它之外的时间，同样也把自己的存在直观为空间。
这后一种生成，即自然，是它活生生的直接生成；它，这个外化出来的精神，在其定在中无非是它的持存的这种永恒外化，以及主体建立起来的运动。

en: The other side, however, of its becoming, history, is the knowing, self-mediating becoming – the spirit externalized to time; but this externalization is equally the externalization of itself; the negative is the negative of itself.

This becoming exhibits a sluggish movement and a succession of spirits, a gallery of images, each of which, furnished with the complete wealth of spirit, moves so sluggishly precisely because the self has to penetrate and digest this entire wealth of its substance.

Since its completion consists in knowing completely what it is, its substance, this knowing is its going-into-itself, in which it leaves its determinate being and hands over its shape to recollection.

In its going-into-itself it is sunk in the night of its self-consciousness, but its vanished determinate being is preserved in that night; and this sublated determinate being – the previous one, but newly born from knowing – is the new determinate being, a new world and shape of spirit.

In it it has equally to begin again from the start, unprejudiced, at its immediacy, and to raise itself up anew from it, as if everything preceding were lost for it and it had learned nothing from the experience of the earlier spirits.
But recollection has preserved them and is the inward and, in fact, the higher form of substance.
If therefore this spirit begins its formation again from the start, seemingly only to proceed from itself, it is at the same time on a higher stage that it begins.
The realm of spirits, which has thus formed itself in determinate being, constitutes a succession in which one displaced the other and each took over the realm of the world from its predecessor.

Their goal is the revelation of depth, and this is the absolute concept; this revelation is hereby the sublation of its depth, or its extension, the negativity of this I that is in-itself, which is its externalization or substance – and its time, that this externalization externalizes itself in itself and is thus, in its extension, just as much in its depth, in the self.
The goal, absolute knowing, or the spirit that knows itself as spirit, has as its path the recollection of the spirits, as they are in themselves and accomplish the organization of their realm.

Their preservation on the side of their free, in the form of contingency appearing, determinate being is history, but on the side of their comprehended organization it is the science of appearing knowing; both together, the comprehended history, form the recollection and the place of skulls of the absolute spirit, the actuality, truth and certainty of its throne, without which it would be the lifeless lonely one; only –
zh: 但它生成的另一面，即历史，是有知的、自我中介的生成——外化到时间中的精神；但这种外化同样是对自身的外化；否定物是它自身的否定物。
这种生成表现为一种迟缓的运动和诸精神的先后相继，一座图像的长廊，其中每一幅图像都配备着精神的全部财富，正因此才运动得如此迟缓，因为自我必须穿透并消化其实体的这全部财富。
既然它的完成在于：完全知道它所是的东西，即它的实体，那么这种知识就是它的进入自身，在进入自身中它离开自己的定在，并把它的形态交给回忆。
在它的进入自身中，它沉没于其自我意识的黑夜，但它已消逝的定在却保存在这黑夜之中；而这被扬弃的定在——先前的、却由知识新生的定在——就是新的定在，一个新的世界和精神形态。
在其中，它同样必须毫无成见地从头开始，从它的直接性开始，并让自己重新由它长大，就好像先前的一切对它都丧失了，它从早期诸精神的经验中什么也没有学到似的。
但回忆保存了它们，并且是实体的内在的东西，事实上是实体的更高的形式。
所以，当这种精神看似只是从自身出发、重新从头开始它的教养时，它同时是在一个更高的阶段上开始的。
以这种方式在定在中形成的这个精神王国，构成一个先后相继的序列，其中这一个接替另一个，每一个都从前一个那里接管了世界的王国。
它们的目标是对深度的启示，而这种深度就是绝对概念；这种启示因而是对它深度的扬弃，即它的扩展，是这个内在于自身的我的否定性，这个否定性就是它的外化或实体；——并且是它的时间，即这种外化在它自身那里外化自己，从而在它的扩展中同样在它的深度中，在自我中。
目标，绝对知识，或者说把自己作为精神来知道的精神，以诸精神的回忆为道路，即回忆它们在其自身那里是怎样的，并完成它们王国的组织。
按照它们自由的、以偶然性的形式显现的定在这一面，对它们的保存就是历史；而按照它们被概念把握的组织这一面，则是显现着的知识的科学；两者合在一起，即被概念把握的历史，构成绝对精神的回忆和骷髅地，构成它的宝座的现实性、真理和确定性，没有这个宝座，它就是无生命的孤寂者；只有——

en: from the chalice of this realm of spirits
zh: 从这座精神王国的酒杯中

en: his infinity foams up to him.
zh: 为它翻涌出它的无限性。
